closed_bespoke_interfaces: GlobalTheory.Published.PoitouTateDuality specialized to exactly its stated finite-module hypotheses
classical_leaves: Local class field theory with arithmetic Frobenius and the specified cup-product order
exact_binding_notes: Finite R modules need not be free.
Invariants are chosen before S, original places, M and its action.
Arithmetic Frobenius and Kummer-left cup require the common negative Brauer-invariant convention.
Conjugation multiplies the scalar cocycle by the root exponent c.
Modified real-place cohomology vanishes for odd ℓ; all archimedean terms vanish in the totally complex case.
No isomorphic replacement field is used.
